title: Applicability of Special Regulations Applying in the Waterfront Area
previewText: The provisions of Article VI, Chapter 2 (Special Regulations Applying in the Waterfront Area) shall not apply in the Special Brooklyn Navy Yard District except as expressly provided in this Chapter.
